errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Try again.

errors.ASSIGNEE_INVALID: The assignee must be an active employee.
errors.DUE_DATE_TOO_EARLY: The needed-by date is earlier than the department accepts.

errors.NOT_DESK_MANAGER: Only the department manager can do this.

errors.ADMIN_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: Platform admin mode is not available for your account.
errors.CODE_ALREADY_USED: This code was already used. Wait for the next code in your app.
